text:
Michelle: Heads-up — partner SI (NovaRetail) says their marketplace onboarding is failing during final validation. 502s when pulling images and the SI reports a cert error. @Ajay can you triage?

Ajay: On it. Do we have the partner error logs? @Devon can you pull the console output they sent?

Devon: paste from partner console: "failed to pull manifest: x509: certificate has expired". Looks like cert rotation hit their registry. Link they sent: https://tiny.redwood/nova-mktg-log

Michelle: they hit this in staging->prod promotion. Asking to hold any further rollouts today. Also want an architecture review to unblock.

Ajay: If it's an expired cert on partner CDN/registry then two paths: partner re-issues with same CA or we temporarily add their new CA thumbprint to allowlist. Need platform + security signoff. @Sara can you check whether our marketplace validation will accept a new root CA without a change?

Sara: Our control plane validates registry cert chains against the trust store used at release time. We don't auto-accept new roots. Quick check of logs shows handshake failures from our agents: `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority`.

Chris: Security POV — allowing arbitrary new CA is risky. If partner is a verified SI and we can validate identity out-of-band, we can add the CA thumbprint to a scoped allowlist for this partner and expire it after rollout. Otherwise advise re-issue to the original CA.

Ajay: For immediate mitigation, suggest instructing SI to rollback to previous image manifest (if available) or pause deployment. Also we can enable fallback to hosted image for this customer's route while we complete verification.

Michelle: I told them to pause. They want a joint call to resolve. Proposed time tomorrow 09:00 PT for an architecture & implementation review with partner and SI. Can everyone join? Need: Michelle, Ajay, Devon, Sara, Chris, and partner lead R. Patel.

Devon: I'll prepare a short diagnostics checklist for the call: cert chain, CA thumbprint, manifest hashes, registry auth, imagePullSecrets, and firewall egress checks. Also will bring the commands we used for triage:

```
# cert chain
openssl s_client -connect registry.partner.com:443 -showcerts
# manifest fetch
curl -v https://registry.partner.com/v2/namespace/image/manifests/latest
# CA thumbprint	openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in cert.pem
```

Ajay: Also ask SI to produce the following pre-read: registry cert PEM, `docker manifest inspect` output for the failing tag, and any proxy/firewall rules recently changed.

Michelle: I'll schedule and send calendar invite + pre-read request to the SI and partner. @deploy-bot can you create the invite for 1765440500?

deploy-bot: meeting invite created: "NovaRetail marketplace onboarding — arch & implementation review" scheduled 1765440500 (tomorrow 09:00 PT). Participants added.

Chris: One more note — if we add a CA thumbprint allowlist, I'll need to document the risk and an expiration window (72h suggested) and verify the fingerprint matches SHA256 from their cert.

Devon: I'll attach a minimal runbook to the invite: steps to rollback, how to verify manifests, and a checklist for re-issuing certs that maintain the same CA chain.

Michelle: Perfect. If anyone sees other immediate mitigations post them here. Otherwise see you on the call. :calendar:

Ajay: Ack. Will prepare a short network/agent log bundle before the call.

R. Patel: Thanks team — we've paused rollout on our side and will send the cert PEM + manifest output before the call.

Michelle: thanks — appreciate the quick coordination. :thumbsup:
